title: UI Component
description: A server-rendered template that renders a node of a resource's JSON in a mode (view or edit).

rbac_context.description: The context the component's write is authorized in on its branch: the branch's context.

branch.description: The name of the branch the component is on; main when absent.

deleted.description: true: a deletion marker, hiding the base's component of this name on this branch. It needs only a name.

base.description: Server-managed: the ETag of the parent branch's component this one overrides, or null.

name.description: The component's name, unique on its branch. A name with a prefix (abc:name) may only override an installed UI layer's item of this kind; the scrud: prefix is reserved.

scopes.description: Maps a property name (or "*" for array items) to the scope name its child is rendered in.

stylesheets.description: Names of stylesheets that also apply to the component's descendants (its subtree below it), not to the component's own node.
